_about: EXAMPLE. install.sh copies this to <data dir>/config/daily.json. imessage_to: the phone or Apple ID email that gets the alert texts. tier_per_day / tier_per_company: how many new roles each run grades, in all and per company (D67). research_per_day: companies researched for Company Radar each day (D76). weekly_email: who gets the Sunday roundup through Apple Mail (D80-D81). packs: prep-pack pace (D85). reminders_list: the Reminders list that makes alerts pop up on your phone (D95).
